about.title: Making sustainability something you can grow with your hands
about.vision: Greenomy makes sustainability and urban greening accessible through technology and community participation — one small plant at a time.
about.why: Most sustainability advice stays abstract. Greenomy turns it into a plant on your windowsill, a photo you're proud of, and points you can actually use.
about.circular: We encourage regrowing food scraps and seeds you'd normally throw away, turning kitchen waste into new life.
about.urban: Even a balcony or a windowsill counts. Greenomy helps cities grow greener, one household at a time.
about.community: Growth is more fun together. Members share progress, tips, and encouragement across the Greenomy community.
